summary: Capture outcomes, owners, and next steps from a meeting in a shareable format.

useCases.title: Draft a post-meeting decision summary
useCases.message: Help me write up a summary from a meeting I just had. Ask me what was discussed or share any notes you have. You might want to check what format I usually use for meeting summaries. Then structure it with key decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines in a format I can send to attendees.
